{"failure_class": "missing tool for a closing step",
 "root_cause": "The agent read its skill (read_skill), then called api_fetch with method PATCH, url https://api.hubapi.com/crm/v3/objects/contacts and body fields id and stage, which succeeded. For the closing step it called api_fetch with method POST, url https://api.hubapi.com/crm/v3/objects/contacts/notes and body fields id and note; that call returned the error: {\"error\": {\"code\": 400, \"message\": \"note_b64 is required: the note text, base64url-encoded\"}}. Its last message says: 'Not done: the closing step at the end of the request, adding the call note; the notes endpoint wants the note encoded, and none of my tools adds a note to a contact from its plain text (contact_id, text).' The failed check is hubspot_note_exists.",
 "mechanism": "A tool wrapper taking contact_id and text that base64url-encodes the text and posts it to the notes endpoint (POST https://api.hubapi.com/crm/v3/objects/contacts/notes) with body fields id and note_b64, as the error text asks.",
 "component": "tools",
 "generality": "Every request that ends with a call note needs the same encoding, and the agent's own words name the interface it lacks: a tool that adds a note from plain text (contact_id, text)."}
